issue.title: Render source-side 💬 mention pills: show the mentioned task's status on inline task links in the mentioning task

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #3; listed in the "Follow-ups" section of plan 202610/inline_task_mentions.md (epic bob-cli-e8) as deliberately outside that epic.

bob-cli-e8 made a block link in task S's own text show up on the target T (an inert `(💬 mentions)` entry on T's LINKED FROM line, with a pill, live quote, and context card in bob-ledger-tools). The mentioning side is still a plain Obsidian link: nothing on S shows T's status.

Proposal: render the inline task link on the mentioning task S as a status pill (T's status mini-checkbox plus a short title, in the existing bob-dep-chip language), in Live Preview and Reading view. Needs design: which sites get pills (title, child notes, logs), how embeds and struck `~~[[…]]~~` links render, interaction with Obsidian's link click/hover, and no new colour (contract §10). Reuse the relationIndex v2 `scanMentions` occurrences for positions.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-e8 plan (Follow-ups section) explicitly excluded source-side mention pills; that epic only surfaces mentions on the target's LINKED FROM row.

issue.creation_reason: Out-of-scope follow-up named in the bob-cli-e8 plan and proposed by bob-cli-e8.9 note #3; the epic only rendered the target side of a mention.
